title: Musya The Cat
body:
A resource pack that replaces one of the cats (red variation) for Musya.

![she has a collar, it is NOT a part of the texture itself](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bacd7699696e299c18b80b143ccbc00d09ff40f8_0.webp)

she has a collar, it is **NOT** a part of the texture itself

.

Musya is a cute, loving and a very strong cat that got through 17 and a half years. But even the strongest of us are vulnerable against cancer.

I've made this resource pack so Musya could continue living in our hearts.
